name: Bacteria
description: The most common cause of plagues. Standard resilience, reliable, and solid base resistance.

name: Virus
description: Rapidly mutating pathogen that is difficult to control. Mutates symptoms randomly for free! Devolving costs DNA.

name: Fungus
description: Fungal spores struggle to travel long distances via planes, but has Spore Burst ability to instantly infect random countries!

name: Parasite
description: Parasitic lifestyle prevents DNA synthesis from normal infection, but is extremely stealthy and avoids human detection.

name: Nano-Virus
description: Out of control microscopic machine. Humanity has detected the lab breach: Cure research begins IMMEDIATELY on day 1!
